limits: Original comparative notes about archived real-product UI; no proof of human authorship, popularity, usability or current source implementation.
Eight distinct frames in five products were visually inspected. This is a bounded part study, not an exhaustive search or a globally best shortlist.
Private native-browser screenshots are hash-identified but not shipped. Public readers must reopen permitted source pages; these notes are not export/capture authority.
No source app interaction, mobile layout, contrast ratio, exact CSS token or accessibility result was verified. Qualitative observations are not pixel measurements.
This map is not a reference pack, component recipe, source selection or approval. Project gates, independent reference review and real Owner decisions remain required.

frames.observed_state: Search/upload panel over the category grid
Empty comparison with three selection slots
Dashboard with filters, metric panels and a local empty state
Transcript and grouped summary side by side
Source media beside selectable extracted claims
Claim explanation and source-summary cards beside the source media

search_record.method: Task-led ordinary UI Bowl browsing, public taxonomy/search and reopening dated frame leads. No hidden endpoint, MCP, scraper, account switch or membership bypass.
comparisons: ClovaNote versus Facticity: continuous original/summary reading versus per-claim explanation and source relationships; neither establishes a complete knowledge-search product.
Magnific versus Facticity: visual category discovery versus evidence-bearing results; vivid media is useful only when media is the task object.
Clarity versus CardGorilla: operational overview versus attribute-by-attribute choice; dashboard tiles must not replace comparable rows.

excluded_leads.reason: Only a scheduling-entry preview was inspected; task mismatch and insufficient fine-craft visibility. Not counted as a studied transferable frame.
No enlarged source image loaded in the current visit; historical popover notes are not fresh evidence.

search_record.stop_reason: Bounded desktop part mapping is documented. Stop before claiming a project shortlist: mobile, focus/error states and end-to-end search/reading still require targeted acquisition.

shared_rules: Choose a product-fit whole-screen anchor separately. Supporting sources answer a named part need; they never each supply a competing theme.
Normalize borrowed principles into the project's authorized typography, spacing, color roles, radii, elevation and density. Do not impose gray/editorial neutrality or copy source literals.
Keep hierarchy relational: primary task before embellishment, data before decorative counters, visible provenance before unsupported confidence.
For every target component record adopted cues, deliberate differences, states and reflow, then compare the implemented artifact to that specification.
Owner source/direction/color/exact-artifact decisions are distinct. Research notes and browser passes cannot grant any of them.
Only the existing source-separated, aliased grammar/recipe projection may reach a creator; this named map is researcher/critic/Owner material.

parts.label: 검색 진입
parts.job: Choose search scope and enter a query without losing the surrounding task.

facts: A wide search control sits above a low-emphasis category grid; small colorful category images carry much of the visual energy.
The search control has a rounded outline and compact icons; category cards pair a rounded thumbnail with a short dark label on a pale fill rather than a loud colored card.
A white bounded panel separates a narrow mode list from a larger input/upload area while the category grid remains visible behind it.
The panel has softened corners and a visible low shadow; an underline marks the selected mode, while the upload region uses a lighter boundary and centered instructions.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Separating scope from input may reduce ambiguity without forcing a new page; that is a design hypothesis, not a measured usability result.

target_craft.anatomy: Labelled scope, query, clear/submit and optional suggestions; add upload only when the product supports it.
target_craft.material: Use the project's input surface, not a decorative hero slab.
target_craft.edge: One readable control boundary; related sub-controls share alignment.
target_craft.depth: Give a temporary suggestion panel one deliberate elevation level.
target_craft.type: Distinguish field label, entered query and help text; do not copy source font.
target_craft.spacing: Group scope tightly with its query; separate results more strongly.
target_craft.color: Reserve the authorized accent for focus/submit/selected scope, not every suggestion.
target_craft.imagery: Use category imagery only when it identifies a real category.
target_craft.motion: Specify focus/open/close behavior; none was observed running.

exclude: Magnific's promotional banner, generator features and image-search taxonomy are not a knowledge-reader brief.
No evidence of search relevance, empty-result handling or mobile reflow.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: compact widths use one query row and a labelled scope control; suggestions fit the viewport and keyboard. This is not observed source behavior.
validation: Native input/submit/clear works; keyboard and IME are supported.
Focus panel does not obscure the active result; long queries do not clip.
Reviewer checks specified material/type/spacing/color in actual target screenshots.

parts.label: 사이드바
parts.job: Expose recurring destinations with clear current location and bounded utility actions.

facts: A labelled left navigation separates note destinations from lower utility items; a thin vertical divider separates it from reading content.
Small line icons sit beside text; the current destination uses heavier text, while account usage gets a separate small colored indicator instead of coloring every navigation row.
A narrow icon rail gives more area to the media grid and marks a selected destination.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Labelled navigation suits unfamiliar destinations; an icon rail may suit frequent expert use. Density alone does not decide which is appropriate.

target_craft.anatomy: Separate primary destinations, account/context and utilities; mark the current destination.
target_craft.material: Match shell surface to the approved project, retaining a distinct content region.
target_craft.edge: Use alignment and a light divider before adding boxes around each item.
target_craft.depth: Navigation itself need not float; overlays require a separate specified layer.
target_craft.type: Use legible destination labels and secondary metadata rather than uniformly bold items.
target_craft.spacing: Group related items; keep utility spacing deliberate, not arbitrarily at every row.
target_craft.color: Selected destination has one consistent role; never borrow source brand colors.
target_craft.imagery: Icons supplement labels unless recognition is demonstrated.
target_craft.motion: Define focus and collapse transitions as proposals.

exclude: An icon-only rail is not universally suitable for Korean labels or first-time users.
Do not import subscriptions, recording actions or unrelated account structures.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: compact navigation becomes an explicitly labelled drawer or reduced destination set, with focus return and no trapped body scroll.
validation: Current location agrees with URL/state.
Keyboard reachability, accessible names and drawer focus return are tested.
Long localized labels remain readable.

parts.label: 탭·필터
parts.job: Change the view inside a stable task without conflating navigation and data filters.

facts: Global navigation, context/date controls and panel-local selected views occupy separate rows; purple/lavender selected treatments are localized.
Local tabs sit at the top edge of their white panel with restrained separators; the filter action is filled more strongly than its neighboring outlined context controls.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: The separation may help users distinguish changing the dataset from changing how it is viewed; this is inferred from one static frame.

target_craft.anatomy: Keep task navigation, query filters and local view tabs separate.
target_craft.material: Use a coherent shared tab strip, not one unrelated card per tab.
target_craft.edge: Give the active tab a visible edge or fill within project rules.
target_craft.depth: Keep tabs on their owning panel plane; do not elevate every tab.
target_craft.type: Use short peer labels; optional counts stay secondary and truthful.
target_craft.spacing: Group peer tabs; reserve space between tab strip and data.
target_craft.color: Active, focus and disabled are separate roles, not only hue variations.
target_craft.imagery: No decorative imagery is necessary for task tabs.
target_craft.motion: Specify state transition and focus behavior; do not claim it was observed.

exclude: Clarity's dashboard taxonomy and metric definitions are not generic tab labels.
No keyboard or filter behavior was executed in the source app.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: compact tabs may scroll within the strip with a discoverable active item; page-level horizontal overflow is not acceptable.
validation: Actual native tab activation and keyboard semantics are tested.
Selection remains identifiable without color alone.
Filter changes do not silently switch or reset unrelated views.

parts.label: 비교표
parts.job: Compare options on the same axes while retaining terms, unknowns and actions.

facts: Option identity and actions align above shared attribute rows; column bands and horizontal rules preserve cross-column comparison.
Dark filled actions share a baseline below the option identities; orange promotional text is limited to a particular row, while ordinary conditions are gray/dark text.
Option names are heavier than issuer metadata; the tall identity area gives way to shorter repeated data rows, and long benefit text wraps inside the shared grid.
An empty comparison preserves three visible selection positions below an explanatory heading instead of drawing fictitious results.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: A shared row vocabulary may reduce comparison effort; visible slots also explain what the next action will populate.

target_craft.anatomy: Identity/header, same-meaning attribute rows, condition details, unknown values and aligned actions.
target_craft.material: Use subtle banding only where it improves row/column tracking.
target_craft.edge: Rules divide comparable facts; avoid a heavy border around every cell.
target_craft.depth: Keep table rows on one plane; reserve elevation for optional disclosures.
target_craft.type: Separate option title, primary measure, unit and conditions; align numeric values where appropriate.
target_craft.spacing: Use repeated cell padding and stable label columns; allow long terms to wrap.
target_craft.color: Apply semantic emphasis only to known differences; no invented best-option badge.
target_craft.imagery: Include a small item image only if it disambiguates options.
target_craft.motion: Define selection/disclosure changes without implying tested source animation.

exclude: CardGorilla's promotions, financial meanings, brand assets and three-option count are not target requirements.
Do not convert all rows to isolated cards if that destroys comparability.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: choose a labelled comparison scroller or grouped attribute view at compact widths; preserve identity, units and conditions. Do not assume the source stacks cards.
validation: Same row means the same attribute across options.
Unknown/missing values are not zeros; conditions remain accessible.
Long labels, compact widths and keyboard disclosures are tested.

parts.label: 결과·근거 카드
parts.job: Make a result's identity, meaning and evidence inspectable before its optional actions.

facts: Source-summary cards have a link-like title, supporting excerpt and a separate relationship badge inside a thin boundary.
Blue source titles contrast with dark reading text; a small tinted relation pill is positioned apart from the excerpt, and the card uses a fine border without a dramatic shadow.
Media-category cards instead emphasize compact colorful thumbnails with short labels.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Evidence-bearing cards need provenance and reading space; visual-category cards need recognizable media. They are not interchangeable card skins.

target_craft.anatomy: For evidence: title, source/date when known, excerpt, relation and inspect action; for media: thumbnail, label and optional count.
target_craft.material: Keep readable card fill distinct from the canvas without a universal paper texture.
target_craft.edge: Use a coherent radius and boundary family; cards in one list share anatomy.
target_craft.depth: Use restrained list-level depth; reserve stronger depth for interaction layers.
target_craft.type: Title leads excerpt; provenance and relation remain legible, not tiny decorative chips.
target_craft.spacing: Align title/excerpt starts and use repeatable internal gaps; preserve enough lines for meaning.
target_craft.color: Links, relations and selection get distinct project roles; not all body text should look clickable.
target_craft.imagery: Only authorized task-relevant imagery; do not copy source media.

exclude: A relation badge or source count does not establish truth or confidence.
Magnific's imagery-first treatment is inappropriate for long evidence text.
Source copy, media and literal colors are excluded.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: compact cards prioritize title, provenance and excerpt; secondary actions move without hiding evidence. Test wrapping instead of adding automatic ellipsis.
validation: Card title and excerpt do not overlap or lose critical content.
Links have names and separate hit targets; relation is not color-only.
Creator implementation is compared to adopted craft cues, not just scanner/browser pass.

parts.label: 지표·상태 카드
parts.job: Provide an operational overview with enough context to interpret a number.

facts: A compact metric strip and repeated white panels contrast with a light blue workspace; larger numbers, smaller labels and localized accent areas create hierarchy.
Top values use dark blue emphasis; insight rows pair pale circular icons with a main value and smaller basis text. Lower panel shadows are faintly colored rather than heavy black.
Magenta/purple occupies a specific ratio bar and selected region; it is not used as a blanket background for all panels.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Repeated hierarchy can make scanning faster, but attractive counters without time, denominator or data provenance are misleading.

target_craft.anatomy: Name, value, unit, period, denominator/basis and optional drill-down.
target_craft.material: Choose a project-authorized contrast between canvas and metric surface.
target_craft.edge: Apply a consistent perimeter and radius; keep dense rows simpler than top-level panels.
target_craft.depth: Small panel separation, not equal heavy shadows on every statistic.
target_craft.type: Value/label/context use a deliberate size-weight relation; unknown is text, not a fake zero.
target_craft.spacing: Align baselines and repeat the same card gutters.
target_craft.color: Accent draws attention to a specific state; semantic colors require truthful status.
target_craft.imagery: Only meaningful small charts/icons with equivalent text.
target_craft.motion: No animated counters unless their effect and reduced-motion alternative are justified.

exclude: A dashboard is not the default form for a reader or search result.
Do not borrow metrics, denominators, benchmark status or fake live activity.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: reduce columns while preserving label-value-context groups; do not truncate units or periods.
validation: Every figure has a real data basis or an explicit fixture/unknown label.
Units/time/context survive compact reflow.
Color and visual emphasis agree with semantics, not magnitude alone.

parts.label: 원문·요약·근거 읽기
parts.job: Read an explanation without losing the original context needed to challenge it.

facts: A continuous transcript with speaker/time markers sits beside grouped summary boxes; document identity stays above the reading area.
Original paragraphs are largely unboxed; summary sections instead use lightly rounded thin boundaries. The document title is heavier than the gray metadata line.
Colored speaker markers and subdued timestamps provide local anchors; summary headings are darker/heavier than their bullet text, with whitespace between sections rather than large shadows.
Source media remains adjacent to a claim explanation, ambiguity text and source-summary cards.
The explanation uses a continuous body-text region before bounded source cards; bold inline terms and section labels create emphasis without boxing every paragraph.
Source media and metadata sit beside a selectable list of extracted claims before processing.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Original and interpretation remain visually related. ClovaNote emphasizes continuous reading; Facticity emphasizes claim-level inspection. Neither alone proves end-to-end knowledge search.

target_craft.anatomy: Original identity, reading body, interpretation and provenance/relationship; keep uncertainty visibly separate.
target_craft.material: Prioritize a quiet reading surface within the project's authorized character, not mandatory editorial beige.
target_craft.edge: Use bounded summaries and source cards; avoid boxing every paragraph.
target_craft.depth: Separate temporary details from reading planes; do not layer panels over required original context.
target_craft.type: Use a readable body rhythm with clear heading/source/time levels; retain Korean and long-text readability.
target_craft.spacing: Give continuous prose a stable reading measure; side detail spacing follows its own repeated rhythm.
target_craft.color: Reserve emphasis for selected passage, links and uncertainty roles.
target_craft.imagery: Media is optional original context, not a compulsory hero.
target_craft.motion: Any source-jump/highlight synchronization is a target proposal, not observed behavior.

exclude: Do not claim summary accuracy, working citations, real confidence or synchronized scrolling from these images.
Do not copy credit/reward actions or source health/factual claims.
No approved TeraWiki/SourcePilot/other-project theme is implied.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: at compact widths show original and interpretation in an explicitly switchable or sequential view that retains a visible return-to-source path; validate reading and focus order.
validation: Original/summary/source are distinguishable in content and semantics.
Every claimed source action actually reaches the intended evidence.
Long Korean text and missing/conflicting evidence do not collapse into decorative cards.

parts.label: 빈 상태
parts.job: Explain an unfilled task and offer the correct next action without faking results.

facts: An explanatory heading and repeated add positions communicate an empty comparison.
A heavier centered heading is followed by lighter help text; pale slot backgrounds, dashed add outlines and small plus symbols distinguish empty positions from actual products.
An illustrated empty watchlist is localized inside the dashboard rather than replacing other data.

parts.rationale_hypothesis: Empty treatment should match whether the whole task or only one region lacks data.

target_craft.anatomy: State explanation, reason when known, one eligible next action and retained surrounding context.
target_craft.material: Use the same container family as the eventual content.
target_craft.edge: Keep placeholders visibly distinct from real result cards.
target_craft.depth: No dramatic overlay for a routine local empty state.
target_craft.type: Action and explanation lead; decorative captions do not replace useful text.
target_craft.spacing: Retain meaningful slot rhythm without wasting the full screen.
target_craft.color: Use project accent on the eligible action, not fake success.
target_craft.imagery: Optional original illustration supports meaning; source illustration is excluded.
target_craft.motion: Define loading separately from empty; do not infer animation from a still image.

exclude: Three source slots do not mandate three target items.
No permission to display working Add/Save when the backend disallows it.
parts.responsive_proposal: Target proposal: keep explanation and eligible action together on compact widths; preserve distinction from errors and loading.
validation: Empty, denied, error and loading have different truthful messages.
Disabled/owner-gated actions are not falsely presented as available.
The local state does not hide unrelated valid content.

parts.label: 모바일·반응형
parts.job: Retain task hierarchy and evidence at compact widths.
parts.rationale_hypothesis: These desktop images cannot establish a source's responsive strategy.
exclude: Do not mark mobile, pointer, keyboard or screen-reader behavior verified from resized archive images.
Do not claim a desktop-to-card transform came from these sources.
parts.responsive_proposal: Acquire permitted same-product compact frames or explicitly label the target adaptation as a proposal. Reflow choices follow the target task, not a universal card stack.
validation: Collect missing source evidence for any claim of source-derived mobile behavior.
Execute target Playwright at scoped compact/medium/wide widths, native pointer and keyboard paths, overflow/clipping and zoom.
Independent critic checks retained identity, reading order, evidence and visual craft; real Owner approval remains separate.
